description: Classification buckets for Ouroboros V2 selfhost phase2 generated-output failures.

buckets.description: Low-level memory lowering helpers or field layout metadata were emitted in a broken shape.
regexes: cannot find value `bit_width` in this scope
cannot find value `field_offset` in this scope
cannot find value `field_bit_offset` in this scope
cannot find value `bit_signed` in this scope

buckets.description: Generated actor or spawn helpers leaked unresolved runtime channel/bootstrap variables.
regexes: cannot find value `tx` in this scope

buckets.description: Parser-side helper residue such as slice helpers or formatting fallbacks leaked into generated Rust.
regexes: cannot find function `slice` in this scope

buckets.description: Ownership and move failures involving Span or dereferenced span values in generated Rust.
regexes: cannot find type `Span` in this scope
cannot find type `Spanned` in this scope

buckets.description: Placeholder lowering artifacts such as bare None or closure/combinator placeholders that are not semantically valid Rust.
Generated return shapes and match arms disagree between Result, Option, and unit contexts.
General generated type-shape mismatches that are not obviously parser/helper or placeholder-specific.
Flattened-file path resolution fallout where module prefixes survive but the generated file is flattened.
regexes: could not find `diagnostic_registry` in the crate root
could not find `ast` in the crate root
could not find `low_level_memory_metadata` in the crate root
failed to resolve: could not find .* in the crate root

buckets.description: Runtime or evaluator helpers were transliterated too literally for bootstrap-stage Rust.
Recurrent helper-specific semantic breakage in generated functions, especially AST rewrite and utility helpers.
regexes: cannot find value `_self` in this scope
cannot find value `param` in this scope

buckets.description: Generated helper methods preserve self-like signatures or fmt/default shapes without preserving impl structure.
regexes: `self` parameter is only allowed in associated functions

buckets.description: Recursive storage or type shape failures in generated Rust.
regexes: cycle detected when computing drop-check constraints

buckets.description: Test-only or dev-only code/dependencies leaking into the phase2 generated lane.
Lowered panic macro calls keep `.to_string()` on literals, tripping format parsing in Rust 2021.
regexes: cannot find function `to_string` in this scope

buckets.description: Fallback bucket for errors not matched by any known rule taxonomy.
